reviewScope.summary: Owner-authorized second Git & GitHub Pathways review, M01–M07: selectable terminal text, state comparisons, concise explanations and accurate result captions.
evidence: Inspected all seven canonical module assets, 47 lesson identities, 113 exercise entries and 62 visual entries. Retained existing renderer and visual registry; 13 entries now have local interaction. No new exercise step, scoring, learner persistence, dependency or service.

Terminal panels preserve literal text, leading whitespace and source-only copy behavior. Seventeen stdout examples revised; eighteen code-result captions distinguish descriptive expectations from actual output. Seven other canonical text blocks revised. The real 92 command scripts and lesson flow topology are unchanged.

Compared the full exercise metadata including all 113 content hashes, module/unit metadata and skills against master 59ecbb77a721780a996b707050bc7d511e6fe094: byte-equivalent JSON values. No new exercise invalidation or migration.
Staging and reset state demonstrations checked using Git 2.47.3 in isolated local temporary repositories. Full Windows PowerShell walkthrough not executed; existing guarded scripts were preserved.

Read-only preflight 46072080932 / job 140751166712 completed successfully. Locked Prettier, canonical generator and --check, lint, typecheck, production build, bundle budget, circular dependency check, 12 targeted Vitest tests and 5 focused Chromium E2E tests passed. Tested terminal selection, clipboard equality, keyboard interaction and mobile layout. Final JS gzip 476868 / 485000 bytes; no budget increase.

Transferred exact canonical generator and formatter output from hosted runner into e5ac281eb33c41e7929c5ebc750a92847837a12f: all 13 returned file blob SHAs independently matched; eight stale generated assets removed. Temporary diagnostic workflow excluded from candidate. No full manual screenshot audit or learner efficacy study; full release suite remains required.

adversarialFindings.description: Plain output panels conflate literal terminal lines and descriptions of expected state.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use selectable terminal styling with exact source copy and separate result captions; keep all guarded script text.

adversarialFindings.description: Static concept diagrams require beginners to mentally reconstruct changes between Git states.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Extend existing local-only visuals for staging, HEAD, remote states, merge methods, reset, stash and validation, with explicit captions and mobile labels.

adversarialFindings.description: Content generation or visual placement could invalidate learner state or reorder steps.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Canonical generation and --check passed, all exercise metadata and hashes, lesson flow topology, 92 command scripts and anchor tests verified unchanged or valid.

adversarialFindings.description: Automated browser tests are not a full manual visual or Windows walkthrough.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Run focused browser checks and isolated Git state tests, preserve existing scripts, require normal release validation; do not claim a comprehensive manual visual or learner outcome assessment.

retrospective.summary: Scoped implementer self-review and successful exact-output preflight. Proceed to required full release validation, then merge only on green checks for exact head. No independent or owner review required. No automation.
